This matrix renders from `data/goodbad_matrix.csv`. To update the results and veredicts, we need to 
update the edit that file (or the fillable
`data/goodbad_matrix.xlsx`, which has dropdowns) and re-render to update the table.

::: {.callout-note appearance="simple"}
Verdicts are intentionally left **TBD**. I believe assigning them is the team's job, and no verdict
stands without the *dimensions assessed* + *evidence* behind it.
:::

```{python}
import pandas as pd
from itables import show          # falls back gracefully; see note below
df = pd.read_csv("../data/goodbad_matrix.csv").fillna("")
df
```


### Evidence IDs

The `Evidence` (R##/Q##) and `Open questions` (DQ##) columns cite entries from the
lit-review database. See the [References](../references.qmd) page for the full entry behind
each ID.
